description: Smithers is an orchestration agent, primarily used to orchestrate maintaining a codebase, but it can be used for orchestration in general. Agents plan, run, and review changes through flows declared beside the code.

support.requiredPlatform: The release candidate's required package platform is Linux with Node 26.4.0.
support.advisoryPlatforms: macOS and Windows package checks are advisory and do not establish a support guarantee.
support.uiCoverage: Offline Chromium tests cover the included web UI.
support.separateAcceptance: Packaged desktop and hosted deployments require separate acceptance evidence.

animation.alt: Monorepo tasks materialize into a planned dependency graph, then execute: each finished step caches its outputs. Agent 1 edits ui/src/button.tsx: only the ui build and test go stale and re-run, the rest comes back from cache. When a docs:api step joins the graph, fed by core/src/parse.ts, an edit to parse.ts re-runs build, test, and docs together. The illustration places the wiki and AGENTS.md downstream of docs, then shows a second agent consuming the wiki. This is the intended refresh pipeline; the app wiki still requires separate generation and publication evidence. A CI scene shows an issue flowing through reproduction, fix, checks, and a human approval gate into a pull request. Finally, a remote cache serves every runner: CI reads and writes it, humans and agents read it.

install.cli:
git clone https://github.com/smithersai/smithers.git
cd smithers
pnpm install
cargo +1.98.0 build --locked --release -p smithers-ffi --bin smithers-jj-export
export PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"
